description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'ViewLeaveEntitlementController' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for managing leave entitlement views. It extends an abstract Vue controller, uses various traits, and handles rendering of leave entitlement information, including employee details, leave types, and leave periods, with access control and dynamic property addition to components.

classes.name: ViewLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller class managing the view for leave entitlements; handles pre-rendering setup, property population, and access control.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee, leave type, and leave period data; enforces access control and permissions.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds the leave type property to the component if leaveTypeId is provided.

methods.name: addLeavePeriodProp
methods.description: Adds the leave period property based on request data or defaults to the current leave period.
